title: Dot product with a set indicator vector
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of its coordinate indices, and let $x\in\bbr_2^n$. The dot product of $x$ with the indicator vector of $S$ equals the sum of the coordinates of $x$ indexed by $S$, with the sum taken in $\bbr_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $S$ of coordinate indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
